description: This file contains the implementation of the GuzzleHttp Client class, which provides methods for crafting and sending HTTP requests asynchronously and synchronously, handling configurations, and managing request options within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A HTTP client class supporting asynchronous and synchronous HTTP requests with configurable options, including handling of base URI, headers, cookies, and request middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the client with optional configuration parameters, setting up default handlers and processing base URI.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for HTTP methods ending with 'Async' or others, forwarding to send requests.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously, waiting for the response.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request following PSR-18 standard, returning a response.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP request.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the client configuration, or a specific option if provided.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Builds and resolves URIs based on base URI and config options.

methods.name: configureDefaults
methods.description: Sets up default request options and environment-based proxy settings.

methods.name: prepareDefaults
methods.description: Merges default configuration options into request-specific options.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Executes the transfer of a request through the handler stack, returning a promise.

methods.name: applyOptions
methods.description: Modifies the request object according to provided request options, such as headers, body, and authentication.

methods.name: invalidBody
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating invalid 'body' option usage.
